meta.title: Show the Account Assignment Category column to tell assets apart in the list

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions list as the buyer.

args.goal: On the Purchase Requisitions list, open the table's manage-columns control, enable Account Assignment Category, close the panel, verify the column appears with asset lines showing A, cost-centre lines showing K, and stock material lines empty, then refresh the page and verify the choice and values remain.

steps.note: Perform and verify the column configuration, row values, and persistence behavior that no dedicated catalog step exposes.
Confirm the newly enabled column remains visible after the on-screen refresh check.
